%md
# Triage Risk Signals with Select AI Agents

This AI4U-style notebook creates finance tools, an agent, a task, and a team in Oracle Machine Learning. It then runs SELECT AI AGENT and verifies the controlled Seer Bank action.

%md
## Inspect the finance evidence

The supplied lookup function reads the existing RISK_SIGNALS_V and SIGNAL_SOURCES_V objects.

%md
## Reset the supplied agent metadata

The platform loader creates a ready-to-run copy. Reset those objects so you can build them yourself as in AI4U.

%md
## Create the finance tools

One tool retrieves risk evidence. The other can write only a constrained analyst-review record after independently checking the threshold.

%md
## Create the agent, task, and team

The role defines the protected boundary. The task requires evidence before action. The sequential team binds the task to the agent.

%md
## Verify the agent components

The inventory should return two tools, one agent, one task, and one team.

%script
SELECT 'TOOL' AS object_type,
       tool_name AS object_name,
       status
FROM user_ai_agent_tools
WHERE tool_name IN (
  'FINANCE_V2_SIGNAL_LOOKUP_TOOL',
  'FINANCE_V2_ESCALATE_TOOL'
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'AGENT', agent_name, status
FROM user_ai_agents
WHERE agent_name = 'FINANCE_V2_RISK_AGENT'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TASK', task_name, status
FROM user_ai_agent_tasks
WHERE task_name = 'FINANCE_V2_RISK_TASK'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TEAM', agent_team_name, status
FROM user_ai_agent_teams
WHERE agent_team_name = 'FINANCE_V2_RISK_TEAM'
ORDER BY object_type, object_name;

%md
## Run Select AI Agent

The active team coordinates the lookup and conditional escalation tools.

%md
## Review the business and native histories

AGENT_ACTIONS proves the business action. The Oracle history views prove how the team and tools executed.

%script
SELECT action_id,
       action_type,
       entity_type,
       entity_id AS signal_id,
       execution_status,
       executed_at
FROM agent_actions
WHERE agent_name = 'FINANCE_V2_RISK_AGENT'
ORDER BY action_id DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT tool_name,
       TO_CHAR(start_date, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS called_at,
       SUBSTR(output, 1, 100) AS result
FROM user_ai_agent_tool_history
WHERE tool_name IN (
  'FINANCE_V2_SIGNAL_LOOKUP_TOOL',
  'FINANCE_V2_ESCALATE_TOOL'
)
ORDER BY start_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT team_name,
       TO_CHAR(start_date, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS started,
       state
FROM user_ai_agent_team_history
WHERE team_name = 'FINANCE_V2_RISK_TEAM'
ORDER BY start_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;

%md
## Prove idempotency

Run the same request again. The escalation function should report that the record already exists, leaving at most one row per signal.

%script
SELECT AI AGENT Run the finance risk triage again and report whether an escalation already exists.;

SELECT entity_id AS signal_id,
       COUNT(*) AS escalation_rows
FROM agent_actions
WHERE agent_name = 'FINANCE_V2_RISK_AGENT'
  AND action_type = 'ESCALATE_REVIEW'
GROUP BY entity_id
ORDER BY entity_id;

%md
## Result

You created and ran a native Select AI Agent over the Finance LiveStack dataset. Its possible actions were limited by registered database tools, and both the business action and native execution remained reviewable.
